steps.name: seed_theme
steps.label: Pre-seed the dark theme choice (what the Display menu stores) -- no production code path for tests
Wait until the theme has actually been applied (it loads asynchronously)

steps.name: probe_login_theme
steps.script: var cs = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement); var token = (cs.getPropertyValue('--np-bg') || '').trim(); var probe = document.createElement('div'); probe.style.background = token; document.body.appendChild(probe); var tokenRgb = getComputedStyle(probe).backgroundColor; probe.remove(); var bodyRgb = getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor; var ok = token !== '' && tokenRgb === bodyRgb && bodyRgb !== 'rgb(244, 245, 247)'; document.body.setAttribute('data-login-theme-probe', ok ? 'follows-theme' : 'wrong:' + token + '|' + tokenRgb + '|' + bodyRgb); return {token: token, tokenRgb: tokenRgb, bodyRgb: bodyRgb, ok: ok};
steps.label: The login page background is the theme's --np-bg, not the page's own fallback
The login page follows the chosen theme
